entities.name: Firehose
entities.rationale: Conceptual representation of Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose for real-time streaming data ingestion.

entities.name: API GATEWAY
entities.rationale: Amazon API Gateway handling incoming API requests and streaming traffic.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Amazon Simple Storage Service acting as primary persistent storage.

entities.name: ECS
entities.rationale: Amazon Elastic Container Service executing containerized processing jobs.

entities.name: SAGEMAKER
entities.rationale: Amazon SageMaker platform used for training and deploying machine learning models.

entities.name: ANALYST
entities.rationale: Data analyst user interacting with or reviewing the machine learning and analytics workflow.

visual_connections.description: Firehose streams ingestion data into Amazon API Gateway.
API Gateway routes and persists streaming payloads directly into Amazon S3.
Data stored in Amazon S3 triggers containerized workloads running on ECS.
ECS processes data and passes features or training pipelines to Amazon SageMaker.
